law_name: Massnahmenpaket zur Weiterentwicklung der integrativen Schule (measures package to develop the integrative school) / counter-proposal to the Foerderklassen-Initiative
description: As education director, Cramer prepared the government's counter-proposal to the cantonal popular initiative 'fuer die Einfuehrung separativer Angebote in der integrativen Schule von Basel-Stadt' (Foerderklassen-Initiative, submitted August 2022). The package, passed by the Grosser Rat in autumn 2024, introduces partially separate Foerdergruppen and Foerderklassen at primary level, 'learning islands' for pupils with acute behavioural difficulties, and additional support services, at an estimated annual cost of about CHF 13.7 million; first measures from January 2025, full rollout targeted by 2028.
significance: Central reform of Basel-Stadt's contested integrative school system; an attempt to ease pressure on regular classes while stopping short of reintroducing traditional small classes (Kleinklassen).

law_name: Teilrevision der Wohnschutzverordnung (partial revision of the housing-protection ordinance)
description: As head of the Praesidialdepartement, Cramer presented a partial revision of the canton's housing-protection ordinance to ease smaller and energy-related renovations: introduction of an annual per-apartment materiality threshold (investments up to CHF 5,000 possible without notification, provided rents are not increased) and removal of the obligation to report minor measures such as installing a dishwasher to the housing-protection commission.
significance: First substantive loosening of Basel-Stadt's strict tenant-protection regime (Wohnschutz) introduced after the 2022 popular initiative; drew criticism from the tenants' association and praise from property owners.
